title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
description: Disregard for alchemy’s laws ripped half of Edward Elric’s limbs from his body and left his brother Alphonse’s soul clinging to a suit of armor. To restore what was lost, the brothers seek the Philosopher’s Stone. Enemies and allies – the corrupt military, the Homunculi, and foreign alchemists – will alter the Elric brothers course, but their purpose will remain unchanged and their bond unbreakable.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After escaping from Central Prison, the Freezing Alchemist, Isaac McDougal, sets his plan in motion to kill Führer King Bradley. However, under the command of Lt. Col. Roy Mustang, the military and State Alchemists attempt to stop him.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: On the way to Lior, Ed and Al reminisce about the events that lead to them being trapped in their current bodies by breaking the taboo of human transmutation. Meanwhile, Colonel Mustang looks back on the first time he met the Elric brothers.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Ed and Al arrive at the city of Lior, hoping to find the legendary Philosopher's Stone so they can return their bodies back to normal. There, they meet a priest named Cornello, who is able to perform "miracles." As Ed and Al investigate, they find out the truth about Cornello.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Ed and Al become interested in biological transmutation after witnessing a chimera in Lior, so Colonel Mustang introduces them to an expert in the field, Shou Tucker, the Life-binding Alchemist. Meanwhile, a serial killer whose targets are only State Alchemists is on the loose in Central.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: After learning about what happened to Shou Tucker and his daughter Nina, the Elric brothers begin to question what alchemy really is. Meanwhile, Colonel Mustang and the other State Alchemists track down the serial killer Scar.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: After their encounter with Scar, Ed's automail and Al's armor need to be repaired, so Major Armstrong escorts them to their hometown of Risembool. On their way there, they spot Dr. Marcoh, a scientist who helped create the Philosopher's Stone, and try to convince him to give them the location of the Stone's research data.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: When Ed and Al arrive at the Central Library they discover that it has been burnt to the ground and instead are taken to see Sheska, a former employee who may have the information they seek. Meanwhile, in East City an unexplained explosion causes Colonel Mustang to restart his search for Scar.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Ed and Al sneak inside the Fifth Laboratory to search for more answers about the origins of the Philosopher's Stone. However, it is not long before they are each attacked by former death row murderers who now guard the complex.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Ed is now in a hospital recovering from his wounds and Al is unable to let go of what Number 66 told him back at the Fifth Laboratory. Meanwhile, Winry agrees to make a trip to Central in order to repair Ed's automail... again!

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: When the conspiracy surrounding the Philosopher's Stone closes in on the highest ranks of the military, one of Mustang's most trusted and cherished allies is murdered.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The Elrics, realizing alchemy has yet to unlock the mysteries of creating life, feel powerless when a new friend goes into labor. Winry, however, jumps into action with a young thief named Paninya.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: While visiting Izumi, their childhood teacher, the Elrics recall the early difficulties of grasping equivalent exchange. They also discover she shares their intimate knowledge of alchemy's greatest taboo.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Al is abducted by chimeras led by the seemingly indestructible Homunculus known as Greed. When Ed's rescue attempt falls short, Izumi proves once more that she's got the brothers' best interests in mind.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: In a violent clash with Greed, King Bradley proves to be a brutal opponent. But the man who finally destroys the Ultimate Shield is more powerful than even the Fuhrer himself.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: The Elrics scuffle with Ling Yao and his attendants, Lan Fan and Fu, visitors from Xing seeking the Philosopher's Stone. Ed may not like him, but Ling Yao's not leaving until he gets what he wants.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: After learning of Hughes's fate, Ed and Al are ravaged by sadness and guilt. Envy still hides in plain sight among the State Alchemists, and another Homunculus is on the verge of infiltrating their ranks as well.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Freed by an unlikely liberator, Ross's escape is interrupted by Mustang. Even those most loyal to the Flame Alchemist are shaken by the controversial action he takes against the accused killer of Maes Hughes.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Ed's journey to a distant land of legend offers surprising new details behind Mustang's alleyway encounter with Ross. After a fateful encounter of his own, Elric learns a stunning secret about Winry's parents.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Mustang, Alphonse, Havoc, and Hawkeye split up to search a military laboratory. If Lust has her way, none of them will ever see each other alive again.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Hohenheim's visit ends with a grave warning to Pinako, but Ed finds hope among the charred ruins of his childhood. Now more than ever, he has confidence that Al can be returned to his body.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Hoping to learn more about the Homunculi, Ed and Al devise a risky strategy to lure the creatures out of hiding. Step one of the brothers' plan: risk death at the hands of their most dangerous enemy - Scar.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Scar's mission to destroy those who slaughtered his people is fueled by justifiable rage. Upon learning the role Scar played in her parents' deaths, Winry claims those murderous feelings as her own.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Cooperation between Mustang's cabal and Ling Yao's band leads to the capture of a Homunculus. Unfortunately, their actions also capture the eye of the Homunculus hiding atop the military's ranks.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Gluttony's twisted powers overwhelm the Elrics - and the creature's appetite is satisfied by battle's end. Meanwhile, Mustang acts on his suspicions of Bradley and finds himself in the belly of the beast.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: The Homunculi are winning. Ed and Ling face a horrific enemy within the hellish expanse of Gluttony's gut. In Central, Mustang can only watch as his loyal band of soldiers is divided by Bradley.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Truths are exposed when Al finds the one called Father, and Mustang hears the tale of Bradley's creation - but the most amazing revelation is reserved for Ed after he once again breaks alchemy's greatest taboo.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: Visions of the past play out by a warming fire as Hohenheim reflects on the unavoidable follies of man: the pain that comes with a loving family; the hidden truths of alchemy; and the roots and results of war.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: The Elrics come face to face with Father - and his face is familiar indeed. Powerless and amazed, Ed and Al can only watch as Father creates a new Homunculus with alchemy that should be impossible.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: The Elrics are at Bradley's mercy; if the brothers make one wrong move, those dearest to them will pay. As Mustang quietly gathers allies at his side, Ed discovers there may be no need to find a Philosopher's Stone.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: As Edward hears Hawkeye's tale of a time when idealistic young soldiers were tasked with genocide, the horrors of the Ishvalan battlefield are revealed.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Even as his subordinates are scattered, Mustang finds he still has allies - unfortunately, so do his enemies. The Homunculi unleash one of the Ishvalan War's most notorious killers to deal with Scar and Marcoh.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: A secret encounter allows Mustang to spark new ambition in an old friend - an ally with loyal troops at his command. Meanwhile, Ed and Al share a chance meeting with their biggest fan - young Selim Bradley.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: The frigid northern borderlands become a battlefield when Kimblee finally closes in on Scar. Deeper into the frozen wasteland, Ed and Al's fight is against the bitter elements as they struggle to reach Fort Briggs.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: The soldiers at Fort Briggs remain ever vigilant against the threat of spies from Drachma. The massive compound may seem impenetrable - but a violent intruder offers destructive proof to the contrary.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: Ed uncovers a conspiracy of staggering scope: a plot that has already claimed countless victims. Clues suggest that Fort Briggs will soon know bloodshed - and an entire nation will suffer.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: As Raven tries to corrupt Armstrong, Ed and Al can only wait in their cell. Long ago, their father faced his own captivity, confined to an eternity of regret in an undying body. To escape the pain, he said goodbye.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: Hawkeye is shocked when the first Homunculus reveals itself. Far away, Edward is surprised by an offer from Kimblee: Fullmetal can have all he has searched for - in exchange for becoming a mass murderer.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: When Scar is cornered by a pair of gruesome chimeras, the Elrics enter the fray as his unlikely allies. Later, Winry's attempt to confront Scar over his role in her parent's death ends in disaster.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: The ruse of Winry's abduction by Scar is revealed, but a plan of rescue must still be hatched. A brutal storm is coming - one which only Alphonse Elric can brave.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 40
episodes_data.description: Long ago, the blood of a simple slave was used in an experiment which created a strange, shapeless being. In exchange for the gift of existence, the being gave the slave a name - and cursed him with immortality.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 41
episodes_data.description: Bound by more than blood, the Elrics have long shared joy and pain. Now, with Al wandering the frigid void - and Ed losing blood by Kimblee's hand - the mystical connection of their souls could prove fatal.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 42
episodes_data.description: May and Marcoh's efforts to decode the research of Scar's brother yield progress, but it might be too late to prevent catastrophe. Violence is spreading across the land, and it will soon reach the northern border.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 43
episodes_data.description: In the snowy north, the soldiers of Fort Briggs engage an invading army, and Marcoh leads an attack against monstrous Envy. In Central, an ominous and shocking secret is revealed to Olivier Armstrong.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 44
episodes_data.description: Hohenheim and Alphonse enjoy a chance to get reacquainted. Their bond is restored with ease, inspiring the father to share his secrets with his sons - but one of them is far away and on the run.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 45
episodes_data.description: Quiet warnings spread near and far: the Promised Day is at hand. While most will face the coming chaos with their own kind, Edward forms a new cabal comprised of human, chimera - and Homunculus.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 46
episodes_data.description: Those who have prepared to reclaim a nation find their plans exposed. The chaos multiplies after an assassin strikes down a mighty leader in broad daylight, and Alphonse falls prey to monsters in the dark.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 47
episodes_data.description: A sinister voice rings out from the shell of Al's armor, and Ed and Greed find themselves under attack. As the Homunculi use the darkness to their advantage, a face from the past arrives to join the battle.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 48
episodes_data.description: After investigating the twisted roots of the Bradley family tree, Mustang gathers his most loyal troops. Meanwhile, Ed and his allies continue fighting Selim, who shocks everyone by turning on his own kind.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 49
episodes_data.description: With his father's help, Al takes incredible steps to contain the monstrous Pride. As the sun begins to rise on the Promised Day, the youngest Elric listens while the Homunculus ponders his very human mother.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 50
episodes_data.description: Mustang leads a ragtag assault force of hardy northern troops - and welcome faces from the past - against Central's defenses. Victory seems certain until the military's most horrifying secret is revealed.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 51
episodes_data.description: Ed's crew faces a horde of ravenous mannequins, abominations powered by human souls. The twisted creatures aren't the only unstoppable force on the battlefield -Pride, Sloth, and Envy are on the move.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 52
episodes_data.description: With a Philosopher's Stone in his possession, Alphonse fearlessly engages Pride and Kimblee. Elsewhere, the Armstrongs find themselves trapped between Sloth's onslaught and the guns of Central's troops.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 53
episodes_data.description: After a startling radio broadcast grants Mustang's forces the advantage over Central's troops, the Flame Alchemist unleashes the brutal power of burning hatred in the battle against the killer of Maes Hughes.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 54
episodes_data.description: As Envy writhes within the firestorm unleashed by Mustang's vengeful rage, Hawkeye must take drastic measures to prevent the Flame Alchemist's hatred from burning out of control.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 55
episodes_data.description: A rebel victory is imminent and hope takes hold among Mustang and Armstrong's troops. Central's forces teeter on the brink of collapse - until their fallen leader returns to take control.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 56
episodes_data.description: Central's forces fight with renewed vigor following Bradley's return, and the Fuhrer himself enters the battle. His first opponent is an armored tank. His second foe is even tougher.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 57
episodes_data.description: The battle for a nation's soul descends into chaos. Bradley unleashes death on those who dare engage him. Beneath Central, the one responsible for the Fuhrer's creation unleashes something far, far worse.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 58
episodes_data.description: Mustang must make a difficult choice: will he break alchemy's greatest taboo? Or will he watch the person dearest to him die? Meanwhile, it grows ever more difficult to discern where Ling ends and Greed begins.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 59
episodes_data.description: As the light of the sun vanishes, Mustang learns the loss which comes from seeing the other side of the Gateway - and five sacrifices gather in the dark presence of the Father.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 60
episodes_data.description: The light is gone. Shadows swallow everything. As the planet quakes and the heavens tremble, the souls of heroes and villains alike vanish into darkness. The circle is complete.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 61
episodes_data.description: Millions of lifeless bodies litter the landscape of Amestris, and a being with the power to create suns is unleashed upon the world. Unless Hohenheim has something amazing up his sleeve, all is surely lost.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 62
episodes_data.description: A truly epic battle erupts when Edward, Mustang, Hawkeye, Greed, Izumi, and Armstrong attack the god-like Father. The odds are against the forces of good - until one brave boy makes a shocking sacrifice.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 63
episodes_data.description: When the battle ends, the one known as Father meets his final fate beyond the Gateway. When the one known as Fullmetal enters the sacred space, he finds only the promise of a new beginning.

episodes_data.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood Season 1 Episode 64
episodes_data.description: As one shared journey ends, many journeys begin. Those most touched by the conflict which surrounded the Philosopher's Stone now go their separate ways. One thing is certain: they will meet again.
